a: 12-factor is a methodology for SaaS apps: config in env, disposability, logs as streams, etc.
Expose /health for orchestrators to know if the instance can take traffic.
On SIGTERM, stop new work, finish in-flight requests, then exit.
Stateless services store session/state externally so any replica can handle a request.
Read configuration from environment variables, not baked-in files, for 12-factor compliance.
Use secret managers (not source control) for API keys and credentials.
Add more instances under load rather than only bigger machines.
Fail fast on broken dependencies and recover after a cooldown.
Bulkheads isolate resources so one failure does not sink the whole ship.
Add random jitter to retries to avoid thundering herds.
